[MatchMiner: An open-source platform for cancer precision medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41698-022-00312-5) describes how MatchMiner works and how clinicians and trial staff at Dana-Farber use it.

By January 2022, Dana-Farber had about 170 open precision medicine trials in MatchMiner, 84% of patients had at least one trial match, and more than 220 patients had enrolled on a trial as a result of a MatchMiner match.
